Witness: photo 0 shows brand label reading “NEXUS” on the front.

risks.risk: Exact model/series and capacity (kg) are unknown, which strongly affects value and pricing.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model/series plate and the capacity rating (kg) label on the machine (front/top rear sticker).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-capacity NEXUS top-loading unit with limited specs.

risks.risk: Working condition is not proven (no evidence of wash/spin cycle, drainage, or heating).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing a full test: power on, selecting a wash program, running wash, then spin/drain (and heating indicator if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified for working condition (worst case: needs service).

risks.risk: Potential leaks, rust, or worn hoses/feet are not shown; these can require immediate replacement.
risks.proof: Photos of the bottom area and hose connections (inlet/outlet/drain), plus close-ups of rubber feet and any visible rust/dents.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible minor wear/leak risk typical of used machines.

risks.risk: Power rating/voltage compatibility is unknown (important in Lagos power setup).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the power rating/voltage label (e.g., V/Hz/W) and plug type.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard but unverified electrical specs.

risks.risk: Accessories and completeness are unknown (hoses, drain hose, manual, warranty card). Missing parts reduce usability.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out (inlet hose, drain hose, power cable/plug, manual, warranty card/receipt).
risks.if_unproven: Price as possibly incomplete (worst case: missing one or more hoses/manual).

risks.risk: Control type/functionality (dial/buttons, error lights) is not visible; could indicate faults not apparent from a single front shot.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the control panel and a clip showing error lights (if any) during power-on and program selection.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the model/series plate and capacity (kg) label.
Short video of a full working test: wash cycle start to completion and spin/drain.
Photos of bottom area, hose connections, and any visible leaks/rust/dents.
Photo of power rating/voltage label and plug type.
Photos of all included accessories (inlet/outlet/drain hoses, manual, warranty card, receipt).
Close-up of the control panel (dial/buttons) and any error lights, plus power-on demonstration.
response.reason: The witness confirms the brand (NEXUS) but key pricing drivers—exact model/capacity and verified working condition—are missing from the report. Without at least a model/capacity label and a test run, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
